text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Syrian President Hafez al-Assad discuss developments in the peace process and ways to boost common Arab action. Mubarak tells a press conference in the south Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh: All parties are required to ponder on how to save the peace process before it is buried.

- Interior Minister Hassan el-Alfi tells Al-Ahram that the banned militant group Moslem Brotherhood is trying to sow the seeds of division between Moslems and Copts. Alfi says he manages to infiltrate its organisations at all levels.

- A delegation leaves in the next few days for a meeting with friendly states and Arab investment funds in Paris. The two-day meeting will start on May 6 and discussions will cover development projects in Egypt in the next five years.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrives in Cairo tomorrow to discuss latest developments in the peace process.
